# Radio

You might say
These options should be mutually exclusive—choosing one should clear the last one.

**Choose exactly one option from a small set**·Radio buttons show mutually exclusive choices such as payment method or visibility. Give the group a clear question and keep all options visible. If there are many options or users need to search, a [Select](/vibe-hub/select?lang=en) may work better.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Show the four pickup slots as one visible radio group with exactly one choice. Verify clicking labels, keyboard changes, and selecting a new slot clearing the previous one.

### When to use it

- Payment method

AllIn progressCompleted
- Visibility level

- Delivery speed

Standard delivery Free · about 3 days

Express delivery ¥8 · arrives tomorrow
- Any short list with one valid answer

### When NOT to use it

- Use it when several options may be selected

BeijingShanghaiGuangzhouShenzhenHangzhouChengduWuhanXi’an…
Too many options are hard to compare quickly

- Use labels that do not explain the difference
